profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ServiceNow

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of a strong team of developers supporting and automating our global cloud infrastructure. The Service Engineering DevOps team is focused on building, operating, and securing our cloud automation manageability suite that automates diagnosis and remediation of various customer life cycle events like instance provisioning, cloning, transfer, and load balancing thousands of ServiceNow customer instances across globally situated server farms.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
The Site Reliability Engineering team is a group of highly technical engineers who are tasked with maintaining and developing the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ServiceNow platform and infrastructure. The SRE is empowered to drive technical resolutions across the stack from application through to hardware, and all levels in between. The ultimate goal of the SRE is to never escalate an issue to an engineering or development team by completely owning resolution of issues in the ServiceNow environment.  They are also tasked with driving forward the operability of the platform to drive down the number of incidents while reducing MTTR.

- Provide relief and sustainable resolution to issues within our infrastructure.
- Use your experience in software development, systems engineering, and networking to proactively prevent repeatable issues.
- Drive initiatives with partner teams to improve the reliability and performance of the infrastructure through improved system design.

positions.title: CloudFront Data Technician
positions.description:
•	Responsible for maintaining efficient operation of data center POP sites throughout the country.
•	Working autonomously in a very fast pace, dynamic environment that may change at any moment due to system failures and redundancy concerns.
•	Experienced in working in a Linux (Redhat) production cluster environment. 
•	Coordinate with vendors to resolve hardware issues with servers including replacing faulty drives and system components.
•	Provide support to a wide variety of enterprise cloud computing hardware including servers and storage enclosures from HP, Rackable Systems, ZT Systems, and Dell.
•	Collaborate with network and system engineers to troubleshoot datacenter network fabric issues during change management windows.
•	Follow strict change management procedures, assessing risk to stakeholders, and clearly detailing all work activity into ticketing/CM system.
•	Prioritizing urgent break fixes in the data center environment while meeting standardized SLA times for repairs.
•	Accustomed to working long hours at irregular shifts to ensure high availability for a global cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Data Center Administrator
positions.description:
•	Primary tasks include planning and deploying server, networking, and storage equipment into enterprise DC as needed by application owners and global infrastructure teams.
•	Perform copper and fiber patching to complete path to core and distribution switches.
•	Troubleshoot and resolve installation issues related to power, cooling, data-plane networking and storage-plane networking. Coordinate with hardware owner’s department for resource and hardware provisioning.
•	Maintain 2 production data centers and 16 campus IDFs with over 100 racks total.
•	Select rack space given power/cooling and scalability concerns; provide hardware recommendations (such as power supplies) to meet hardware owner needs and align with data center capabilities. 
•	Maintain monitoring appliances and configure thresholds to ensure power and air-cooling units are performing within capacity watermarks.
•	Schedule break-fix and preventative maintenance for DC and server equipment with vendors.
•	Monitor status of DC equipment and notify application owners of issues or degraded states.
•	Implement safeguarding such as physical disaster risk reduction, N+1 power redundancy with secure connections and maintain diverse network path.
•	Label and update documentation related to network cable patching.

positions.title: Technical Operations Lead
positions.description: Provide technical support to all distribution center and corporate location with PC issues, active directory, exchange as well as some basic AS/400 troubleshooting. Duties include troubleshooting PC's, installing hardware, configuring RF devices, monitoring AS/400 system, imaging and deploying images to systems, route patch cables in the data center, installing server hardware, managing/troubleshooting printers and exceptional customer service.
